description: This file defines a class `UnitTestFontResolver` implementing `IFontResolver`. It provides font resolution logic for unit tests, mapping font family names and styles to font files, and loading font data from asset paths.

classes.name: UnitTestFontResolver
classes.description: Provides font resolution and loading logic for unit tests, mapping font family names and styles to specific font files from assets.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Converts font family name and style (bold, italic) into specific font resolver info, supporting predefined fonts and delegating others.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Loads font data bytes for a given face name from the corresponding asset directory.
